messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick intake — want to bring tile model 'tilt-13B-q4' into Hosted/Dedicated for chat+tooling. Need checklist for prompt formatting, tool calling, structured output, quant regressions, and perf benchmarks. Who takes ownership? :wave:

Ashwin: I'll own initial bring-up. Proposed quick checklist:
1) Run quantized inference smoke (q4 -> p50/p95 latency + mem)
2) Run regression evals (factuality, instruction-following, hallucination rates)
3) Create chat-template & tool-call examples, ensure strict JSON-mode tests
4) Add structured-output schema + CI strictness checks (jsonschema)
5) Benchmark cost/token vs baseline and measure tokenization differences
6) Canary with rollback/fallback to baseline model

Ashwin: Example chat template (use system + turn metadata):
```
System: You are a concise assistant that outputs JSON only for the "response" field.
User: {{user_text}}
Assistant: {
  "response": "<answer string>",
  "sources": ["<url>..."],
  "confidence": "<low|med|high>"
}
```

Jess Lee: Quick perf numbers from q4 run (local NVMe dev box): p50 110ms, p95 360ms, tokens/sec ~18, token cost est ~0.6x baseline. Noted: more truncated outputs on long-prompts (possible KV eviction or cache sizing mismatch).

Samir Khan: Prioritization matrix proposal:
- Safety / factuality regressions: blocker
- Tool-call integrity (JSON validity + schema): blocker
- Latency within 1.5x baseline: high priority
- Cost reduction >20% vs baseline: medium
Assign numeric scores and we make go/no-go rules.

Jess Lee: Minimal structured-output schema we should gate on (jsonschema snippet):
```
{"type":"object","properties":{"response":{"type":"string"},"sources":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"confidence":{"enum":["low","med","high"]}},"required":["response","confidence"]}
```

Maria Gomez: On tool-calling — please ensure the runtime preserves function-call envelope and we validate return types in the platform shim. Example tool stub we should use in tests:
```
"tools": [{"name":"search","args_schema": {"q":"string","max": "integer"}}]
```

Ashwin: Regression prompts to add to CI:
- multi-hop fact QA (10 seeds across domains)
- instruction-following edge cases (truncation, contradictory constraints)
- tool call roundtrip with malformed tool outputs (ensure graceful failure)

qa-bot: QA checklist created: https://redwood.internal/qa/tilt-13b-q4 (stub). Owners: Ashwin (eng-ml), Jess (bench+eval), Maria (prod rollout). Next steps: run full regression suite + create canary route with fallback to baseline.

deploy-bot: FYI — created ephemeral canary route tilt-13b-q4-canary, auto-scale off by default. Triggered CI job #542.

Maria Gomez: Thanks — we'll reconvene after CI. Please drop any weird failure logs here. :thumbsup:
